era: Sega Saturn / HD remaster / Wii action
summary: Sonic Team's dream-flight action series, beginning with the Saturn classic NiGHTS into Dreams and continuing with the Wii sequel Journey of Dreams.

entries.title: NiGHTS into Dreams
entries.definitive_edition: HD PC remaster for main play, plus Saturn/Christmas NiGHTS for removed extras

emulation.emulator: Native PC if owned; Mednafen/Saturn hardware for original extras
emulation.notes: Use PC HD for main capture and Saturn for missing bonus-mode coverage.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: True HD 16:9 on PC/PS3/Xbox 360; Saturn extras remain lower-fidelity.

primary.why: The HD remaster is the highest-fidelity route, with true HD 16:9 presentation on PC/PS3/Xbox 360 and enhanced graphics/original Saturn graphics options; PC is the preferred capture route when already owned.
primary.how_to_play: Play the owned Windows PC HD version if available, using the enhanced or Saturn-style graphics mode to taste. Use Saturn emulation or hardware for the original two-player mode and fuller Christmas NiGHTS bonus context.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original Saturn-era content context, including the original two-player mode and Christmas NiGHTS/Sonic bonus material that the HD version does not fully preserve.
secondary.what_to_play: Use the Saturn original and Christmas NiGHTS sampler for removed multiplayer/bonus-material coverage.
secondary.why: Christmas NiGHTS includes bonus content, and the HD version removed the two-player mode and Sonic the Hedgehog level.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Saturn release with 3D controller support and Saturn-era modes.
all_releases.reason: secondary: lower fidelity than HD, but preserves original modes and the fullest Christmas NiGHTS context.

all_releases.fidelity: Japan-only remake with widescreen support and classic Saturn graphics option.
all_releases.reason: skip: useful transitional remake, but superseded visually by the later HD ports.
skip: strong HD route, but PC is preferred for capture when owned.
skip: strong HD route, but PC is preferred for capture when owned.

all_releases.fidelity: HD PC remaster with enhanced/original graphics options.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity and most capture-friendly route, with a delisting caveat.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PC HD is best-looking, but Saturn/Christmas NiGHTS preserves original bonus and multiplayer material that the HD version removed.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Steam release was delisted in December 2024; the HD version includes Christmas NiGHTS but removed the two-player mode and Sonic level.

entries.title: NiGHTS: Journey of Dreams

emulation.notes: Dolphin can improve capture clarity; use original hardware if Wii Remote feel matters most.

primary.why: Journey of Dreams is the Wii-exclusive sequel, with multiple control options, local and online multiplayer modes, and the My Dream system tied to the Wii Forecast Channel.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Wii disc on Wii or Wii U hardware with the controller style you prefer, or use Dolphin for clean capture/upscaling while checking rhythm/flight input latency.

all_releases.reason: primary: only official platform and complete release.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Only the Wii release is documented.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official remaster or port is documented.
